concerns.title: Failure of the sufficient margin does not make existence unresolved
concerns.quote:
If this
condition fails under nonzero noise, positivity feasibility is unresolved;
concerns.analysis: Take Y=0 and epsilon>0. Least squares gives Hhat=0 and Chat=0. The estimate itself is a compatible positive-integral solution, while Chat-r_H I/4 is not PSD. The quoted blanket existence conclusion fails. The retained decoder already returns true in this case, so this is a local statement defect, not failure of the recovery theorem.
concerns.suggested_fix: Separate existence from an all-compatible guarantee. State the PSD-estimate case, the non-PSD singleton case, and the genuinely unresolved case.

concerns.title: Make the spanning dictionary and extraction usable
concerns.quote:
Any unwanted constant and linear commutator can be corrected by h, since
h contributes tr(h)X-[h,X].
concerns.analysis: The argument spans the claimed family, but leaves readers to reconstruct all coefficient contractions and the correcting h. This is an exposition/completeness gap, not a counterexample.
concerns.suggested_fix: Supply A, R, Gamma and D, the complete integral-to-normal dictionary, an explicit converse h, and Choi/partial-trace coefficient extraction.

concerns.title: Disambiguate Gram K from one-body K and fix coordinate conventions
concerns.quote: Since20K-G is positive definite and V^TV=3I,
concerns.analysis: K here is the 21-by-21 action Gram matrix, while the linked normal form uses K for a 3-by-3 traceless matrix. Code uses model["K"]. Shapes, vectorization order, zero-based minor rows, probe order and physical units need explicit local definitions.
concerns.suggested_fix: Use B=M^T M in the reading edition, document the code field, give the full determinant/probe tables, define row vectorization and units.

concerns.title: Repair compressed numerical prose and supply a reader route
concerns.quote: # Fixed-spin molecular sector: exact21-parameter normal form
concerns.analysis: The title and repeated constructions such as giving6 and symmetric3x3 combine words with numerals. Other notes compress symbols and assumptions without a shared glossary.
concerns.suggested_fix: Correct spacing, punctuation, grammar and transitions throughout; add a notation/unit guide and previous/next navigation.

concerns.title: Qualify replay equality by the numerical environment
concerns.quote:
Thus the Hamiltonian,
action-error cap and response are identical,
concerns.analysis: Identical retained arrays imply the same exact rational Hamiltonian. Floating matrix products and their measured cap can vary with numerical-library/platform builds. The checked replay agrees in the observed environment; cross-platform equality of the floating cap has not been established.
concerns.suggested_fix: Record versions and fresh input/output manifests. Require each replay to measure its own floating error cap and validate its own reference inclusion.
